$note: Named team archetypes, sourced from Prydwen's Team Tier List (Tower of Adversity view) archetype labels — each row on that list names the archetype as '<Character> <Archetype Shape>' (e.g. 'Jinhsi Hypercarry', 'Aemeath Mono Fusion'). The tier-list page itself did not render member-composition text in this session's JS extraction (icon-only team rows) — example 3-member comps below are instead pulled from that lead character's own characters/<slug>.json 'teams' section (same Prydwen build-page source, cross-referenced by slug), which is more detailed anyway (named sub-variants, budget alternatives, notes on why a slot works).

shapeDefinitions.Hypercarry: One Main DPS stays on-field for the large majority of the rotation; the other two slots are pure buffers/healers whose entire job is to land their Outro Skill (elemental DMG / All DMG / Crit buffs) onto the Main DPS and then get out of the way. Rewards a single character's investment (weapon/echoes) over spreading resources, and rewards buffer Outro uptime/duration over the buffers' own damage.
shapeDefinitions.Dual DPS: Two damage-dealing characters alternate on-field time roughly evenly (via quickswap or via one triggering the other's burst window), each buffing or debuff-setting for the other through their own Outro/Intro/Liberation, rather than one pure DPS being fed by two pure supports.
shapeDefinitions.Mono: All three team members share one element so every elemental-RES debuff, elemental DMG Bonus buff, and (where relevant) element-specific Sonata/Echo-set bonus applies to the whole team uniformly — trades team-building flexibility for stacking depth on a single damage type.
shapeDefinitions.Rupture: Built around the element-agnostic Tune Break/Tune Rupture stagger mechanic (see resonance-chain-mechanics.md §7): the team's rotation is sequenced to keep breaking the enemy's Tune gauge for repeated Rupture burst damage and the Interfered vulnerability window, rather than around a single character's Forte nuke.
shapeDefinitions.Echo: Named for Phrolova's own kit terminology (her Resonance Liberation/Forte mechanic is explicitly called an 'Echo'-branded stance in her kit); the archetype centers her self-sufficient on-field loop rather than a hypercarry buffer chain.
shapeDefinitions.Fusion Burst: Named for Aemeath's kit-specific 'Fusion Burst' finisher mechanic; the team is sequenced to detonate her burst payoff rather than a generic elemental-buff hypercarry loop.
